title: Shows like The Magnus Archives
description: Case-file horror with an expanding mythology for listeners who want strange encounters to add up to something larger.
label: Case files and consequences

showReasons.the-lovecraft-investigations: A reporting-led investigation that grows from strange cases into a much larger cosmic horror story.
showReasons.archive-81: Recovered recordings, occult history, and an expanding mythology make it a natural archival-horror branch.
showReasons.old-gods-of-appalachia: A narrated regional mythology gives each new story the weight of something older underneath it.
showReasons.the-silt-verses: A darker serialized route where faith, institutions, and supernatural power keep widening the frame.
showReasons.knifepoint-horror: The cleanest anthology detour when the standalone case-file dread is the part you want most.
showReasons.scp-archives: A dossier-shaped anthology for listeners who enjoy strange reports accumulating into a larger catalog of dread.
showReasons.the-black-tapes: A skeptical investigation route when the research, recordings, and escalating paranormal question are the hook.
showReasons.a-voice-from-darkness: Call-in supernatural warnings preserve the intimate, voice-led feeling of being told about something you should not investigate.
